Our client is a highly respected international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and client service. With a collaborative and professional culture, the firm combines high standards with a supportive working environment where people are encouraged to take ownership and make an impact.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the daily operations of the Brussels office
• Lead and support administrative and office services teams
• Oversee facilities, office maintenance, and workplace experience
• Coordinate suppliers, contractors, and external service providers
• Manage vendor relationships, tenders, and contract negotiations
• Monitor office budgets, expenses, and operational costs
• Organise office events, meetings, and internal initiatives
• Drive process improvements and operational efficiency projects
• Ensure compliance with health & safety and local regulations
• Coordinate onboarding and support employee experience initiatives
• Act as the main contact for landlords, building management, and external stakeholders
• Collaborate closely with leadership and international support teams
• Support business continuity, ESG, and office governance initiatives
• Coordinate local IT-related office needs and employee support

• Minimum 10 years of experience within a law firm, consultancy, or similar professional services environment
• Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken (mandatory)
• Dutch is a strong asset
• Previous people management or team leadership experience
• Excellent organisational and project management skills
• Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset
• Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Professional, discreet, and service-driven
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office and digital tools
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

Inetum is a European leader supporting organizations as they navigate continuous technological change.

With deep industry expertise, a strong innovation culture, and a scalable international model, we help clients transform their operations and generate sustainable impact across business and society.

Guided by European values, we empower local businesses to create positive impact and unlock society's full potential. This vision drives us to deliver on our promises, attract the best talent, and turn uncertainty into opportunity, building a future where technology unleashes the possibilities within us all.
Job description

Are you a freelance Java Developer, DevOps Engineer or Solution Architect looking for your next challenge?

We are continuously looking for experienced Java professionals for a variety of IT projects across Antwerp, Brussels, and hybrid working environments.

You will contribute to innovative software projects involving Java development, cloud-native applications, DevOps practices, software architecture, and digital transformation initiatives. Whether you are a senior developer, an architect, or a technical lead specialist, we would love to hear from you.
Project opportunities

Assignments may include:

• Java Development

• Senior Java Development

• DevOps Engineering

• Solution Architecture

• Software Architecture

• API and Integration Projects

• Application Modernization Initiatives

• MicroServices and Event-Driven Architectures

Interested?

Not available right now? No problem.

Feel free to send us your CV, areas of expertise, availability, and daily rate. We will get in touch as soon as we identify an opportunity that matches your profile.

Stay connected and be the first to hear about exciting freelance Java, DevOps, Cloud, and architecture opportunities across belgium.

Depending on the project, you may work with technologies such as

• Java 17 and Java 21

• Spring Boot

• Azure Cloud

• TerraForm

• Docker

• Kubernetes

• GitHub

• GitHub Actions

• CI/CD Pipelines

• REST APIs

• MicroServices

• Event-Driven Architectures

• SQL Databases

Who we are looking for

• Experience as a Java Developer, DevOps Engineer or Architect

• Strong knowledge of modern Java technologies and software engineering practices

• Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments

• Familiarity with cloud platforms

• Strong analytical and communication skills

• Available as a freelancer or open to future freelance opportunities

• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French

Assistant Housekeeping Manager (m/f/x)Job DescriptionYour Focus: The well-being of guests and employees. You will assist with the coordination and management of the Housekeeping department.In addition, you will be responsible for:- Sharing responsibility for ordering and deliveries within the Housekeeping department- Collaborating with internal and external cleaning staff- Ensuring and implementing Motel One’s housekeeping standards, as well as being responsible for cleanliness in all areas- Sharing responsibility for conducting internal coaching sessions, cross-training, and onboarding new housekeeping employees- Gaining cross-departmental insights into new areas of work through collaboration in our multicultural teamsBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.QualificationsWhether you’re a seasoned hotel professional or looking to change careers—you’re a great fit for us! That’s because personality and hospitality skills are our top priorities! You also stand out because of:- Training in the hotel industry or professional experience in the hotel, restaurant, or retail sectors, or an interest in changing careers.- A passion for developing employees—ideally with some initial leadership experience- A strong focus on quality and service, as well as hospitality skills and a passion for the hotel industry- An open, communicative demeanor, good manners, and strong verbal and written communication skills in French and English.The ability to work well in a team and a willingness to provide cross-departmental support—we achieve our success together.

F&B ManagerJob DescriptionAs the F&B Manager at The Cloud One Hotels, you are entrusted with overseeing all F&B outlets. Alongside your team, you'll delight our guests with our locally sourced organic breakfast or the nightly "Sounds in the Clouds," featuring captivating beats at our bar. Your key responsibilities include:- Orchestrating, coordinating, and supervising operational workflows across our F&B outlets- Leadership and development of the F&B team, including recruitment, onboarding, skill enhancement, and ongoing educational initiatives- Collaborating on event planning and execution alongside our Guest Service Agent Events- Achieving revenue goals while managing cost budgets- Upholding hygiene standards and maintaining cleanliness in our F&B spaces- Building and managing relationships with local suppliers, in line with the Motel One Group's central procurement- Participation in the conception and design of our F&B offers- Enforcing workplace cleanliness and compliance with hygiene regulations- Collaborating seamlessly across departments and brandsBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.QualificationsWhether you're a professional in the hotel industry or considering a career change, we're enthusiastic about meeting you! For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:- Experience in hospitality, gastronomy, or tourism, ideally within F&B- Passion for hospitality and team leadership- Strong commitment to quality and service excellence- Awareness of trends in gastronomy, events, and design- Proactive nature and eagerness to develop and implement innovative concepts (e.g., F&B offerings or events)- Entrepreneurial mindset, organizational skills, and proficiency in MS Office- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments

jobs.description: **Location:**  GhentClient confidentialTransport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. This is us, your new colleaguesYou will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.This is the job- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business Are you the one?- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.- Well-being services- Restaurant on site- Opportunity to grow within the company- Good work life balance- International environment- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.Your responsibilities: 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.Working hours are from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system: 
• Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
• Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You perform well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You are stress-resistant and thrive in a production environment where pace is important. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.
